NX_TAC_RECALC.name: Strategic Recalculation
NX_TAC_RECALC.description: One of your units on an SP restores 1 HP and 1 DEF, up to its maximum values.
NX_TAC_RECALC.effectText: One of your units on an SP restores 1 HP and 1 DEF, up to its maximum values.

NX_TAC_BLOCK.name: Blocking Protocol
NX_TAC_BLOCK.description: Deals 1 damage to an enemy on or adjacent to an SP.
NX_TAC_BLOCK.effectText: Deals 1 damage to an enemy on or adjacent to an SP.

NXTAC01.name: Mortar Strike
NXTAC01.effectText: Deals 2 damage to an enemy unit.

NXTAC02.name: Precision Artillery
NXTAC02.effectText: Deals 4 damage to an enemy unit.

NXTAC03.name: Jam Missile
NXTAC03.effectText: Deals 2 damage and removes positive buffs from the target.

NXTAC04.name: Aerial Bombardment
NXTAC04.effectText: Deals 1 damage to units in the selected cell and adjacent cells, allied and enemy alike.
NXTAC04.notes: R3 from a living allied unit or structure.

NXTAC05.name: Tactical Passage
NXTAC05.effectText: Marks a cell: for the current turn, units passing through that cell gain +1 movement and may move again.

NXTAC06.name: Trench
NXTAC06.effectText: Marks a cell: the next unit that passes through it has its movement blocked until the next turn.

NXTAC07.name: ENE Recalculation
NXTAC07.effectText: Gain +1 ENE for each occupied SP and an additional +1 ENE if your Commander is in play.

NXTAC08.name: Request Supplies
NXTAC08.effectText: Draw 1 card; if it is a tactic, draw 1 additional card. Cards drawn by this effect permanently cost 1 less ENE, to a minimum of 1 ENE.

NXTAC09.name: Impenetrable Defense
NXTAC09.effectText: Applies Phase Shield: the unit cannot be targeted by attacks, abilities, or tactics.
NXTAC09.notes: The status was originally planned as Phase Shield.

NXTAC10.name: Disable Systems
NXTAC10.effectText: The target unit cannot move, attack, or use abilities.

NXTAC11.name: Advanced Targeting
NXTAC11.effectText: The unit attacks while ignoring the target's DEF.
NXTAC11.notes: Can be implemented as an ignoreDefenseOnAttack tag/status.

NXTAC12.name: Field Repair
NXTAC12.effectText: Restores the target unit's HP to its maximum.

NXTAC13.name: Repair Kit
NXTAC13.effectText: Choose one: restore up to 2 HP or up to 2 DEF, without exceeding the respective maximum.
NXTAC13.notes: A human player uses an explicit dialog; the bot chooses the larger recovery.

NXTAC14.name: Multispectral Visor
NXTAC14.effectText: All Stealthed enemy units within a straight-line R2 of the chosen cell lose Stealth. They can gain the status again later.

EX_TAC_ORDER.name: Assault Order
EX_TAC_ORDER.description: One of your infantry units and an adjacent vehicle gain +1 ATT until the end of the turn.
EX_TAC_ORDER.effectText: One of your infantry units and an adjacent vehicle gain +1 ATT until the end of the turn.

EX_TAC_PUSH.name: War Push
EX_TAC_PUSH.description: One of your vehicles that has not yet activated moves +1 and can still act.
EX_TAC_PUSH.effectText: One of your vehicles that has not yet activated moves +1 and can still act.

EXTAC01.name: Anti-Tank Artillery
EXTAC01.effectText: Deals 2 damage, or 3 damage if the target is a Vehicle.

EXTAC02.name: Heavy Artillery
EXTAC02.effectText: Deals 4 damage to an enemy structure.

EXTAC03.name: EMP Missile
EXTAC03.effectText: Deals 2 damage and permanently reduces the target's ATT by 1.

EXTAC05.name: Attack Maneuver
EXTAC05.effectText: The unit can move again after attacking.

EXTAC07.name: ENE Recalculation
EXTAC07.effectText: Gain +1 ENE for each enemy unit destroyed this turn, up to +3.

EXTAC08.name: Incoming Supplies
EXTAC08.effectText: Draw 2 cards. Vehicle cards drawn by this effect gain +1 permanent ATT.

EXTAC10.name: Static Field
EXTAC10.effectText: All enemy units in play have +1 ENE ability cost until the next turn; free abilities remain free.

EXTAC11.name: Targeting Device
EXTAC11.effectText: If the unit gets a kill with a basic attack, it can attack again. Maximum 1 extra attack.

EXTAC12.name: Varran's Order
EXTAC12.effectText: The target unit doubles its ATT for its next attack.

EXTAC13.name: Imperial Targeter
EXTAC13.effectText: The target permanently gains Vision R2 and +1 ATT. Cannot stack on the same unit.
EXTAC13.notes: Vision uses the runtime vision tag.

EXTAC14.name: Mechanic
EXTAC14.effectText: The Vehicle restores up to 3 HP, without exceeding its maximum HP.

LX_TAC_HORDE.name: Horde Charge
LX_TAC_HORDE.description: One of your units and its adjacent allies gain +1 ATT until the end of the turn.
LX_TAC_HORDE.effectText: One of your units and its adjacent allies gain +1 ATT until the end of the turn.

LX_TAC_RAID.name: Swift Raid
LX_TAC_RAID.description: Marks an enemy; if it dies this turn, gain +1 ENE.
LX_TAC_RAID.effectText: Marks an enemy; if it dies this turn, gain +1 ENE.

LBTAC01.name: Call the Militia
LBTAC01.effectText: Deploy 2 Liberti Militiamen, one on each of the two selected cells.

LBTAC02.name: Call to Arms
LBTAC02.effectText: Deploy 1 Liberti Raider on a free deployable cell. The Raider gains Vanguard only for the turn it enters play.

LBTAC03.name: Call of the Clans
LBTAC03.effectText: Priority spawn: first 1 Liberti Raider, then Militiamen up to a maximum of 3 total units, respecting valid cells and the unit cap.

LBTAC04.name: The Clan Answers
LBTAC04.effectText: Fills free cells adjacent to the Commander with Liberti Militiamen, up to 6 and within the unit cap.

LBTAC05.name: Dirty Grenade
LBTAC05.effectText: Deals 1 direct damage and applies Bleeding 1.

LBTAC06.name: Demolition Charge
LBTAC06.effectText: Deals 5 direct damage to the enemy structure.

LBTAC07.name: Final Run
LBTAC07.effectText: The next basic attack deals +1 damage. After the attack, deal 2 damage once to each unit adjacent to the attacker and target, allied and enemy alike. Then destroy the infantry unit.

LBTAC08.name: Mark of the Sanguis
LBTAC08.effectText: The infantry unit's next basic attack applies Bleeding 2 to the target it hits.

LBTAC09.name: Raiders in Ambush
LBTAC09.effectText: The infantry unit gains Ambush: the first time an enemy unit moves adjacent to it, it makes an opportunity attack. Maximum 1.

LBTAC10.name: Pit Champion
LBTAC10.effectText: The infantry unit permanently gains +1 ATT for each adjacent unit when this card is played, up to +4.
LBTAC10.notes: Cannot be reapplied to the same unit.

LBTAC11.name: Clan Tribute
LBTAC11.effectText: Draw 1 card. If the first card drawn is infantry, draw 1 additional card. Maximum 2 cards drawn.

LBTAC12.name: The Horde Moves
LBTAC12.effectText: The selected units move with doubled MOV. After moving, they count as having acted and cannot attack or use abilities.

LBTAC13.name: Sanguis Hunter
LBTAC13.effectText: The infantry unit gains a permanent passive: each enemy infantry kill with a basic attack increases the Bleeding value applied by its future attacks by +1.
LBTAC13.notes: No initial cap; monitor this effect.

LBTAC14.name: Attack Bait
LBTAC14.effectText: All valid adjacent allied infantry immediately make an opportunity attack against the target, even if they have already acted. No chains.

AG_TAC_ROOTS.name: Defensive Roots
AG_TAC_ROOTS.description: One of your units on an SP or structure gains Thorns 2 for one turn.
AG_TAC_ROOTS.effectText: One of your units on an SP or structure gains Thorns 2 for one turn.

AG_TAC_WALL.name: Green Wall
AG_TAC_WALL.description: Your units adjacent to one of your structures restore +1 DEF, up to their maximum.
AG_TAC_WALL.effectText: Your units adjacent to one of your structures restore +1 DEF, up to their maximum.

AGTAC01.name: Green Barricade
AGTAC01.effectText: The selected cell becomes impassable for 2 rounds.

AGTAC02.name: Plant Anathema
AGTAC02.effectText: The cell gains Plant Anathema for 2 rounds. If occupied by an enemy: -2 temporary ATT. If occupied by an ally: +2 permanent DEF. Consumed on first activation.

AGTAC03.name: Thorn Path
AGTAC03.effectText: The first enemy unit to occupy the cell loses 1 DEF, to a minimum of 0, and has its movement blocked until the next turn. Allies ignore the effect. Consumed when triggered.

AGTAC04.name: Timber Bastion
AGTAC04.effectText: Sets the structure's current DEF equal to its current HP. This can exceed base DEF/maxDef. Does not modify HP, maxHP, or ATT.

AGTAC05.name: Vigilant Nature
AGTAC05.effectText: The infantry unit gains Counterattack: if it survives an enemy basic attack, it immediately attacks the aggressor. Maximum 1.

AGTAC06.name: Green Fortress
AGTAC06.effectText: Bonus calculated when played: +2 current DEF for each adjacent structure; +1 maximum HP for each adjacent allied infantry unit. The maximum-HP bonus does not heal.

AGTAC07.name: Thorn Mantle
AGTAC07.effectText: The unit gains Thorns 2 until the next turn. Thorns do not stack: if it already has Thorns, use the higher value.

AGTAC08.name: Merchant Caravans
AGTAC08.effectText: Draw 1 card for each living allied structure in play, up to 4 cards.

AGTAC09.name: Seed of Wealth
AGTAC09.effectText: The structure gains a permanent passive: at the start of your turn, gain +1 ENE while this structure remains in play.
AGTAC09.notes: No extra cap: the natural limit is 2 deck copies.

AGTAC10.name: Green Fury
AGTAC10.effectText: Swap current ATT and current DEF until the end of the round. Restoring the values preserves damage and changes that occurred during the effect.

AGTAC11.name: Agathoi Ballista
AGTAC11.effectText: Deals 2 normal damage to an enemy unit.

AGTAC12.name: Minefield
AGTAC12.effectText: Places a mine on each cell. Each mine is consumed on the first passage and deals 1 direct HP damage to an allied or enemy unit.

AGTAC13.name: Deployment
AGTAC13.effectText: Deploy two Agathoi Wardens on two valid adjacent cells. They enter exhausted and without Vanguard.

AGTAC14.name: Agathoi Sentinel
AGTAC14.effectText: The Infantry unit permanently gains Vision R2, +1 maximum/base DEF, and +1 current DEF. Cannot stack.

FB_TAC_CHOKE.name: Logistics Choke
FB_TAC_CHOKE.description: Marks an enemy; if it attacks, Fabeot gains +2 ENE.
FB_TAC_CHOKE.effectText: Marks an enemy; if it attacks, Fabeot gains +2 ENE.

FB_TAC_CONTRACT.name: Onerous Contract
FB_TAC_CONTRACT.description: The enemy pays +1 ENE to purchase units until the end of their next turn.
FB_TAC_CONTRACT.effectText: The enemy pays +1 ENE to purchase units until the end of their next turn.

FABTAC01.name: Hypnosis
FABTAC01.effectText: Applies Stun: the target cannot move, attack, or use active abilities.
FABTAC01.notes: Commanders and Pivots are allowed in the first version; monitor this effect.

FABTAC02.name: Mentalist Diploma
FABTAC02.effectText: The unit permanently gains: when it hits with a basic attack, the target is stunned until the next turn.

FABTAC03.name: Forced Discharge
FABTAC03.effectText: The unit returns to its owner's hand as a clean base card, without statuses, damage, buffs, or modifiers.

FABTAC04.name: Doctrine of Betrayal
FABTAC04.effectText: Permanently convert the target infantry unit. The converted unit is inactive and cannot act this turn.

FABTAC05.name: Bounty
FABTAC05.effectText: If the target is destroyed this turn, Fabeot adds a clean base copy of that unit to their hand.

FABTAC06.name: Onerous Contract
FABTAC06.effectText: Both players draw 1 card. If the card drawn by Fabeot is a tactic, Fabeot also steals the card just drawn by the opponent.

FABTAC07.name: Embargo
FABTAC07.effectText: Blocks 1 random card in the opponent's hand for each SP controlled by Fabeot. Blocked cards cannot be played for 1 turn.

FABTAC08.name: Assassin's Contract
FABTAC08.effectText: The target gains a permanent negative passive: each kill it makes with a basic attack immediately gives Fabeot +1 ENE.

FABTAC09.name: Usury Contract
FABTAC09.effectText: The opponent loses 1 ENE from their reserve and suffers -1 ENE income for 2 turns. If they had 0 ENE before this card was played, they discard 1 random card.

FABTAC10.name: Stealth Device
FABTAC10.effectText: The vehicle gains Stealth until it attacks, uses an ability, or is detected. Movement does not break Stealth.

FABTAC11.name: Bomb Package
FABTAC11.effectText: Choose a target cell within R1 and up to 2 valid adjacent cells; every unit on the chosen cells takes 1 damage, allied and enemy alike.

FABTAC12.name: Deceptive Attack
FABTAC12.effectText: The infantry unit's next basic attack ignores the target's DEF and deals damage directly to HP.

FABTAC13.name: Double Strike
FABTAC13.effectText: Deals 1 normal damage, then resolves a second 1-damage hit against the same target if it is still alive.

FABTAC14.name: Heavy Double Strike
FABTAC14.effectText: Deals 2 normal damage, then resolves a second 2-damage hit against the same target if it is still alive.
